analysis.summary: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited reported strong growth in H1 FY27, with pre-sales reaching INR879 crores and EBITDA margins expanding to 39.9% in Q2. The company added three new projects to its pipeline, bringing the total to 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores. Management remains confident in meeting its FY27 guidance for pre-sales, revenue, and PAT growth. The company maintains a net cash position and plans to launch four additional projects in H2 FY27. Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited reported a strong second quarter for FY27, with pre-sales growing 83% year-on-year to INR 470 Crs and total revenue rising 52.5% to INR 269 Crs.

guidance.claim: Management expects to sustain EBITDA margins between 35% and 40% and PAT margins between 25% and 30%.
guidance.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining strong profitability, with EBITDA and PAT margin expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.

guidance.claim: The company remains confident of delivering its stated guidance for FY27 of pre-sales of INR 1,800-2,000 Crs, and revenue and PAT growth of 55-60% over FY26 levels.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of delivering our stated guidance for FY27 of a pre-sales of INR 1,800-2,000 Crs, and revenue and PAT growth of 55-60% over FY26 levels.

guidance.claim: The company remains committed to its FY27 guidance of pre-sales between INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.
guidance.quote: Backed by this launch pipeline, strong demand outlook, and the quality of our developments, we remain committed to our FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.

guidance.claim: Management expects to sustain EBITDA margins of 35% to 40% and PAT margins of 25% to 30%.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of sustaining strong profitability with EBITDA and PAT margins expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.

demand_outlook.claim: Management believes the luxury segment is less sensitive to interest rate hikes compared to affordable housing.
demand_outlook.quote: While this is likely to weigh on affordable and mid-income housing, the luxury segment is far less sensitive to borrowing costs.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in the Mumbai luxury market is driven by end users upgrading to larger homes.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand is driven largely by end users upgrading to larger homes in better locations, while scarce land in prime micromarkets makes redevelopment the principal route to new supply, precisely where Lotus has built its capability.

demand_outlook.claim: There is strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces in the GIFT City Area project.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces, coupled with differentiated project positioning and strong brand name translating into high enquiry levels for luxury residential units.

demand_outlook.claim: Q2 FY27 pre-sales grew 83% YoY to INR 470 Crs, with six projects contributing, showing that demand is spread across the portfolio rather than resting on a single project.
demand_outlook.quote: Q2 FY27 pre-sales grew 83% YoY to INR 470 Crs, with six projects contributing, which shows that demand is spread across the portfolio rather than resting on a single project.

demand_outlook.claim: Luxury housing demand in Mumbai has grown by more than 11%.
demand_outlook.quote: Even as the overall housing market has moderated, luxury housing demand across the city has grown by more than 11%, led by successful families and professionals upgrading to bigger, better homes.

capex_expansion.claim: The company added three new projects during the quarter with a combined GDV of INR2,700 to INR2,800 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Three new projects added, Lotus Impressa at Shivaji Park in Dadar West, Lotus Stellar in Versova, and Lotus Supremus in Juhu, which adds INR2,700 to INR2,800 crores of GDV to existing GDV pipeline.

capex_expansion.claim: Four projects are planned for launch in H2 FY27 with a combined GDV of INR3,500 to INR4,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We plan to launch four projects, Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to INR4,000 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company was appointed as preferred developer for three new projects: Lotus Supremus, Lotus Empressa, and Lotus Stellar, and secured additional area for Lotus Insignia, which together adds INR 2,700-2,800 Crs of GDV.
capex_expansion.quote: We also made significant progress on business development during the quarter, where company was appointed as preferred developer for three new projects: Lotus Supremus (Juhu), Lotus Empressa (Shivaji Park, Dadar West), Lotus Stellar (Versova) and additional area secured for Lotus Insignia which together adds INR 2,700-2,800 Crs of GDV.

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched two new projects in Q1 FY27 with a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we launched two new projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, together representing a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27 with a combined GDV of INR3,500 to 4,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we plan to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27: Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to 4,000 crores.

margins_costs.quote: EBITDA more than doubled to INR107 crores, with margins expanding to 39.9%.

margins_costs.claim: The company attributes its strong margins to being net debt-free, low marketing spend, and fast project cycles.
margins_costs.quote: As far as margins are concerned, as I have mentioned earlier, we are a net debt-free company. So, we don't have to pay or we don't have any burden of interest. Second, till today, we have not done any marketing expenses, very limited awareness campaign we did. So, that is where we don't spend much money on that. Third is our project cycle is very fast.

margins_costs.claim: In Q2, total revenue rose 53% YoY to INR 269 Crs, EBITDA more than doubled to INR 107 Crs at a margin of 39.9%, and PAT grew 91% to INR 89 Crs.
margins_costs.quote: In Q2, total revenue rose 53% YoY to INR 269 Crs, EBITDA more than doubled to INR 107 Crs at a margin of 39.9%, and PAT grew 91% to INR 89 Crs.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported a PAT margin of 34.5% for Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax grew 77% year-on-year to INR46 crores, at a PAT margin of 34.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Marketing expenses are expected to be approximately 1% of pre-sales.
margins_costs.quote: Of course, our expense would be I would say about 1% approximately, but that also will be able to recover because what happens that during this advertising, there would be many clients we will be getting directly, where we will not be spending any money on brokerage.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's pipeline comprises 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: With these additions, our ongoing and upcoming pipeline now comprises 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores, of which 19 are redevelopment-led.

orders_capacity.claim: For H1 FY27, pre-sales stood at INR 879 Crs, up 176% YoY.
orders_capacity.quote: For H1 FY27, pre-sales stood at INR 879 Crs, up 176% YoY and on track to achieve our full-year guidance.

orders_capacity.claim: Lotus Trident led with INR 178 Crs in its first full quarter, representing approximately 38% of pre-sales.
orders_capacity.quote: Lotus Trident, our premium commercial launch in Andheri West, led with INR 178 Crs (~38% of pre-sales) in its first full quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 22 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR17,500 to 18,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Our ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 22 projects, 17 residential and 5 commercial, with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR17,500 to 18,000 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company held a net cash position of INR494 crores as of September 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: As of 30th September 2026, we had a net cash position of INR494 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: INR305 crores of IPO proceeds had been deployed as of September 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: INR305 crores had been deployed as on 30th September 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Proceeds from the fresh issue of the IPO amounting to ~INR 550 Crs are being invested in subsidiaries for part-funding development and construction costs of ongoing projects Amalfi, The Arcadian, and Varun.
capital_allocation.quote: Investment in our Subsidiaries, Richfeel Real Estate Private Limited, Dhyan Projects Private Limited and Tryksha Real Estate Private Limited for part-funding development and construction cost of our Ongoing Projects, Amalfi, The Arcadian and Varun, respectively amounting to ~INR 550 Crs.

capital_allocation.claim: As of June 2026, the company had a net cash position of INR623 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of June 2026, we had a total cash balance of approximately INR776 crores against debt of INR153 crores, resulting in a net cash position of INR623 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: The RBI repo rate hike is expected to impact affordable and mid-income housing demand.
risks_headwinds.quote: Earlier this month, RBI raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.5%, its first increase since early 2023. While this is likely to weigh on affordable and mid-income housing, the luxury segment is far less sensitive to borrowing costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that luxury buyers are not driven by loan rates, but acknowledged broader market uncertainty.
risks_headwinds.quote: While most buyers globally are being cautious, given interest rates and broader uncertainty, luxury buyers are not.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to launch four projects in the second half of the fiscal year.
management_commitments.quote: We plan to launch four projects, Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to INR4,000 crores.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to complete three projects in the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Siddarth, it is depending on the which stage the project is there. In the last year and in the '24, '25 also, some of the project were on the completion stage. So, at the time of the completion stage, the collection always be the 90%, 95% is due. So that's reflect in the balance sheet. The same will be you'll see that once the project will be completed, so next year we are aiming that three projects will be completed, then these three projects you will see the collection will be the 95% to 100% the collection.

management_commitments.claim: Four launches are planned for the second half, including Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, Lotus Odyssey, and Lotus Aurelia, with a combined estimated GDV of ~INR 3,500-4,000 Crs.
management_commitments.quote: As we enter the second half, we are well prepared. Four launches are planned, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, Lotus Odyssey, and Lotus Aurelia with a combined estimated GDV of ~INR 3,500-4,000 Crs.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains on track to achieve its full-year pre-sales guidance.
management_commitments.quote: For H1 FY27, pre-sales stood at INR 879 Crs, up 176% YoY and on track to achieve our full-year guidance.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to dilute promoter stake to 75% or below within the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: So, we have got total three years. One year has passed, so we have still two years to go. And within that time, I think we'll be able to dilute that.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to collect around INR1,000 crores in cash this year.
management_commitments.quote: So, this year we are intend to collect around INR1,000 crores.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
